protocol.population: Two previously unused official series, selected together. Three answerable queries and one missing measure per table. No engine outputs inspected during selection.
protocol.freeze: Scores for both sources must use one identical candidate hash on the first and only prospective comparison against the fixed baseline. Preserve the outcome even when it worsens.
protocol.selection: Use the full small numeric block and the original headers. Mix natural questions, adjacent-period or adjacent-measure false numbers, and one definition. Do not rank-test variants or inject labels into data rows.
protocol.primary: For answerable queries Hit@k = count whose predefined evidence row appears among the first k candidate centers / 6, k = 1, 3. Rank is 1-based. A header or context-only match does not count. Also report separately per source, denominator 3. These ranks assess row retrieval, not individual cell interpretation.
protocol.controls: Separately report raw candidates returned versus none out of 2 unanswerable queries. An unranked answer, explicit UI abstention, and a candidate excerpt are distinct outcomes. This raw rank experiment does not measure UI abstention, article accuracy, bias or editor time.
protocol.unit: 1-based nonempty source lines. Join the displayed source lines with LF. Whitespace and tabs in a displayed row separate physical table cells. Year/month group labels and repeated rows stay separate, with no header enrichment.
protocol.ties: Use original deterministic engine order. No alternate gold or scoring adjustments after freeze.
